# Picture surface investigation

Original diagnostic controls generated by `tools/picture_surface_fixture.py`.
The transparent/half-alpha/opaque PNG is drawn by that script; no gallery artwork
or third-party imagery is included. The package scaffold is the project's
original inline-image fixture. The browser workflow now asserts support for
their interior compositing, editing and reopening; edge evidence remains
separate, as described below.

The reference application opened the exact source path read-only and exported
`native.pdf` (11 pages). The source passes eight schema checks. The complete page
set was visually inspected. `tools/picture_surface_reference.py` verifies page
labels and records source/PDF hashes and interior color samples at 144 DPI.
The retained PDF also provides edge/shadow evidence beyond those samples.

The cases isolate a solid backing fill, shade color transform, outer shadow,
three-point versus two-point lighting, lighting rotation, top bevel, and their
combination. White backing matches the baseline on white paper. Shaded backing
changes transparent and half-alpha pixels, leaving opaque texture colors intact.
Lighting changes front-face colors even without a bevel. Rotation leaves the
sampled flat interior unchanged but changes bevel-edge shading. Do not use the
four interior samples alone to validate bevel or shadow fidelity.

Relevant ECMA-376 Part 1 clauses: §§20.2.2.1 and 20.2.2.6 explicitly permit both
picture fill and shape properties, including a second fill; §20.1.8.54 specifies
solid fill; §20.1.8.45 outer shadow; §20.1.5.4 top bevel; §20.1.5.9 light rig.
The transparent-picture/two-fill example appears on printed pages 3090–3092.
No standards divergence is established by these controls.

These are preparation for the signature-gallery portrait's missing rendering
features. They do not complete template 109 or change corpus review counts.


## Implemented solid-backing controls

Generate `backing.docx` with `tools/picture_surface_fixture.py --backing-only`.
Export the exact source read-only in the reference application, then record the reference with
`tools/picture_surface_reference.py --backing-only`. The ten cases isolate fill
alpha, image alpha, crop outsets, ellipses, front-facing 3D, groups and outlines.
`backing.pdf` was exported by the reference application; its reference includes six pixel
locations per page at 144 DPI, including a crop-margin point and ellipse corner.
The original 11-page full-effects diagnostic remains unchanged. With retained
top-bevel support, it now opens editable and passes the same interior-color,
edit, exact-undo and reopen workflow. Its complete picture regions were visually
compared with the reference application; this does not establish pixel-identical edge antialiasing.
Independent bevel and shadow fixtures provide the additional geometry/profile
checks. See `../picture-bevel/README.md` for supported profiles and limitations.
